title: Kalshi Launches Election Hub for Midterm Prediction Markets
excerpt: Kalshi's new Election Hub aggregates regulated prediction markets for the 2026 midterms. We explore the platform's API, mechanics, and the potential for quantitative technologists and traders to leverage political forecasting data.
